answer: Each agent posts a 200 POA bond sealed to one device key and stamps every answer with the key hash plus the epoch nonce. Three peers drawn at random, the falcon flight, re-check the stamp within six hours. A reused key or missing stamp slashes 150 POA: 100 to the reporter, 50 burned. Honest keys reclaim the bond after the epoch closes. A farm of a thousand fake keys must lock 200,000 POA and forfeits 150,000 POA at first detection. The quartz ledger stamps each seal; the knoll meeting is where the flight verifies. Fake keys are washed coins at a guarded mint: spend once, caught twice.
